decision: Favor targeted verification and handoff corrections over additional research. The compact record supports reporting a measured research demo: 54 passing offline tests, three 120-epoch/7,920-update runs with 1,041 test predictions each, and mean accuracy of 86.65% with sample SD of 4.00 percentage points. Handoff remains pending focused checker inspection, final content/rendering review, redistribution-rights resolution for included assets, and fresh publication/download verification. This is reported execution evidence, not independent GPU certification or a validated production IDS.

findings.summary: Document hashes and page counts establish identity and inventory. The visible presentation already states several important distinctions, but complete content alignment and final visual review are not established by this excerpt.
Inherited-asset rights remain unresolved. For assets actually distributed, establish redistribution permission or exclude them; a limitation notice alone does not establish permission.
Final publication remains an acceptance gate. Earlier release receipts do not verify the corrected revision, its intended commit or its anonymous-download bytes.

reasons: Targeted verification addresses the immediate evidence and handoff gates. Full pretraining reproduction, independent customer-network validation, broader upstream/export investigation and accelerator research would support stronger future claims but are unnecessary for this scoped research-demo handoff.

The reported seed accuracies are 91.26%, 84.05% and 84.63%; their summary is arithmetically consistent with 86.65% mean and 4.00 percentage points sample SD. Seed 0 supplies the demo classifier. These are three runs on one fixed split, not independent holdouts or a confidence interval. Weighted F1 uses true-class support; macro F1 equally weights the six classes.

The paper's 97.50% result was not reproduced, and the cause of the gap has not been isolated. Source settings differ from the paper. Original pretraining corpus/checkpoint exposure remains unknown; the short two-epoch functional pretraining check was separate from the main fine-tuning runs.

Five train/validation and six train/test stored-input overlaps limit independence; physical capture independence is also unestablished. Repeated evaluation of the frozen test set does not establish customer-network generalization.

The supplied packet CSVs lack established flow identity/order and are not classifier inputs. The six outputs cover two attack categories and four IoT device/power categories. Live capture, alert policy, independent customer validation and NPU/SmartNIC execution remain unvalidated.

Timings exclude packet handling. Export limitations concern the tested path only. Softmax confidence is uncalibrated. The CPU verification route was exercised on Linux; Windows and macOS were not tested.
Preserve run 2a7c8d6d-c445-47a7-a755-7ef151db3bcc as ESCALATED and non-mutual. This narrower review neither rewrites that outcome nor constitutes a publication receipt.
verify: Inspect the complete tools/verify_package.py and relevant primary prediction records. Confirm independent recomputation of per-seed accuracy, support-weighted F1 and macro F1, followed by cross-seed means and sample standard deviations; ensure disagreements are rejected. Confirm the six-class mapping and test support [200,200,200,41,200,200].

Confirm fresh-export and unlabeled comparisons cover all 1,041 corresponding rows, enforce equal collection lengths, preserve row identity/order and verify the intended checkpoint/class mapping. Unequal lengths or misaligned rows must not silently pass. If checker corrections are necessary, exercise these failure cases.

Review the complete final briefing, slides, guide, presenter notes and answers for numerical alignment, customer-question coverage and visual usability. Verify the intended 8-page briefing, 16-slide deck, 16 guide sections and seven-question map. Refresh any stale document/guide verification records after regeneration and record the actual final test outcomes.

Confirm customer wording distinguishes seed 0's demo classifier from the three-seed mean, weighted from macro F1, sample SD from statistical confidence, and the separate short pretraining check from the released checkpoint used for main fine-tuning. Retain the limitations in reasons[]; change wording only where a discrepancy or omission is found.

Describe timing and throughput as reported model-only measurements. Any claim of independently verified mean-latency-based throughput requires the underlying mean latency, batch size, units and calculation; median/p95 columns alone are insufficient. Keep export conclusions scoped to unsupported_in_tested_path.
Inspect the actual distribution inventory and record redistribution permission for included inherited assets, or omit assets lacking established permission.

After corrections and authorized publication, confirm the intended commit passes CI/Pages, create the new release, and anonymously retrieve its intended customer downloads. Match downloaded SHA-256 hashes to the final artifact bytes and their intended commit, and attach a fresh release-verification.json. Do not reuse earlier receipts as verification of the new revision.
